newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX energy futures firm on ACCESS after gas draw.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX energy futures firm on ACCESS after gas draw.

text.p: U.S. energy futures prices rose in the ACCESS overnight market Tuesday after an unexpectedly sharp draw in national gasoline stocks, traders said.
U.S. gasoline on hand at refineries fell 3.6 million barrels last week, after some analysts forecast a 1.50 million-barrel build for the week ended May 2.
"People liked the gasoline number," one trader said.
Crude oil for June delivery on NYMEX traded at $19.73 several hours into ACCESS, up seven cents a barrel from the daytime close of $19.66.
About 390 lots traded in June and 1,150 in all months.
After-hours, NYMEX June heating oil rose 0.12 cents a gallon to 53.75 cents, as 90 lots changed hands in the front month and 115 in all months, traders said.
NYMEX June unleaded gasoline futures climbed 0.39 cents a gallon as 200 lots traded in June and 320 total.
Trade stayed in narrow range overnight, with traders nervous about which way the market would next move.
"People are looking for a breakout in either direction," a trader said.
